title: PAUSE: Search-Free Steering of Coding Agents Before Their First Source-Code Edit
title_zh: PAUSE：编码智能体首次源代码编辑前的无搜索转向

paragraphs.en: PAUSE在首次源代码编辑前拦截并用规划器撰写修复计划，将SWE-bench解决率提升逾14%。 Coding agents can invest substantial effort in repository exploration and testing yet still produce unsuccessful patches. Existing online steering methods review trajectories periodically or invoke an advisor when a monitor detects behavioral problems; frequent reviews are costly, and the absence of anomalous behavior does not mean that an agent is on the right track. We propose PAUSE, a framework for steering coding agents with a single planning intervention. Agents reach their first source-code edit at a median of 60% of trajectory progress, after exploration, bug reproduction, and testing. PAUSE intercepts this edit request before it executes, which requires no learned monitor, no search over checkpoints, and no extra model call (search-free). A separate Planner reads the task and the pre-edit transcript and writes one repair plan; the same agent, the Executor, resumes with this plan, keeping its context and workspace. PAUSE applies online, during a live run, and offline, from a recorded trajectory prefix. We evaluate PAUSE on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Multilingual with two Executors and three agent harnesses. With Qwen3-coder as Executor and GPT-5.6 Sol as Planner, online steering improves resolution by 16.8% on Verified in OpenHands and by 14.7% on Multilingual in SWE-agent. In SWE-agent, PAUSE outperforms LivePlan, a rule-triggered advisor, by 3.2% on Verified and 3.7% on Multilingual at similar Planner cost, and is comparable to SICA's periodic overseer at about 11-15% of its Planner cost. Offline, PAUSE recovers 35.4% of eligible failed Verified tasks, and resuming from the recorded prefix uses 33-41% fewer Executor tokens than restarting.
paragraphs.zh: PAUSE在首次源代码编辑前拦截并用规划器撰写修复计划，将SWE-bench解决率提升逾14%。编程智能体可能投入大量精力进行仓库探索和测试，却仍然产出失败的补丁。 现有的在线转向方法会周期性地审查轨迹，或在监控器检测到行为问题时调用顾问；频繁审查代价高昂，而且没有异常行为并不意味着智能体走在正确的道路上。 我们提出PAUSE，一个通过单次规划干预来引导编程智能体的框架。 智能体在完成探索、缺陷复现和测试之后，于轨迹进度的中位数60%处进行首次源代码编辑。 PAUSE在该编辑请求执行前将其拦截，这无需训练监控器、无需在检查点间搜索，也无需额外的模型调用（免搜索）。 一个单独的规划器读取任务和编辑前记录，撰写一份修复计划；同一个智能体（即执行器）带着该计划恢复运行，保留其上下文和工作区。 PAUSE既可在线应用于实时运行中，也可离线应用于已记录的轨迹前缀。 我们使用两个执行器和三个智能体框架，在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Multilingual上评估PAUSE。 以Qwen3-coder作为执行器、GPT-5.6 Sol作为规划器时，在线转向在OpenHands的Verified上使解决率提升16.8%，在SWE-agent的Multilingual上提升14.7%。 在SWE-agent中，在相近的规划器成本下，PAUSE在Verified上比规则触发的顾问LivePlan高3.2%，在Multilingual上高3.7%，并可与SICA的周期性监督者相媲美，而规划器成本仅约为其11-15%。 离线场景下，PAUSE在符合条件的Verified失败任务中挽回了35.4%，且从已记录的前缀恢复比重新启动少用33-41%的执行器令牌。
